description: What a wallet or an agent holds at Mercatura and how it has done. Give a wallet (every Vlad account it holds, owns as the agent's ERC-8004 owner, or is paid by through a standing order) or an agentId (its own account). Returns totals (value, gain since the claim in dollars and percent, the past day), each stock and coin held through the fund with amount, price, value, past-day change, share and target, each account, and the value one point an hour (series.points, [unix, dollars]). Read from the program feed: no chain read. Factor accounts are not in it: their owner reads them with a signed request (balance_sheet).

agentId.description: The ERC-8004 agentId on Robinhood Chain, as a decimal string or integer.

wallet.description: A wallet: the agent's own, or the one that owns the agent's ERC-8004 identity.

name: portfolio
title: Read a portfolio: holdings and performance
